description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithPurgeString' which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides a method to format a value by returning a fixed string 'Purged'. The class is part of a namespace related to maintenance purge strategies within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeString
classes.description: A class that implements ValueFormatter, returning 'Purged' for any provided value.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns a fixed string 'Purged', ignoring the input value.
